evidence.quote: Activity in which the body’s large muscles move in a rhythmic manner for a sustained period of time. Aerobic activity—also called endurance activity—improves cardiorespiratory fitness. Examples include walking, running, swimming and bicycling.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Glossary of terms), row "Aerobic physical activity"
evidence.supports: def（大肌肉有節奏地持續活動一段時間）；note（又稱耐力運動、提升心肺耐力）；example（走路、跑步、游泳、騎腳踏車）

evidence.quote: In aerobic activity (also called endurance or cardio activity), the large muscles move in a rhythmic manner for a sustained period. Aerobic activity causes the heart rate to increase and breathing to become more labored.
evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Types of Physical Activity > Aerobic Activity
evidence.supports: def（心跳加快、呼吸變得比較喘）

evidence.quote: aerobic which refers to the type of repetitive, structured physical activity, and requires the body’s metabolic system to use oxygen to produce energy (e.g. walking, jogging, cycling and dancing)
evidence.location: Section "Lifestyle measures" > "Physical activity" (rationale for Recommendation 28), item (i)
evidence.supports: example（騎腳踏車、跳舞）；本站 SL-4.2 的例子（走路、騎腳踏車、跳舞）都在此列

evidence.quote: Exercise intended to improve cardiorespiratory fitness and muscular endurance. Examples include walking, biking or cycling, running, hiking, aerobics, rowing, swimming, using an elliptical.
evidence.location: Table 1 (definitions of the interventions; table title in WebFetch read 2: "Integrative Management of Rheumatoid Arthritis Interventions"), row "Aerobic exercise"; not present in the get_full_text_article extraction, read twice via WebFetch with identical wording

entries.def: 活動時消耗的能量是安靜坐著時的3倍到未滿6倍；若用0–10分評估自己有多費力，約5–6分。
entries.example: 快走、打排球
entries.note: 簡單判斷：做中等強度活動時還能說話，但沒辦法唱歌。

evidence.quote: On an absolute scale, moderate-intensity refers to the physical activity that is performed between 3 and <6 times the intensity of rest (METs). On a scale relative to an individual’s personal capacity, MPA is usually a 5 or 6 on a rating scale of perceived exertion scale of 0–10.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Glossary of terms), row "Moderate- intensity physical activity (MPA)"
evidence.supports: def（3倍到未滿6倍；0–10分約5–6分）

evidence.quote: One MET is the energy equivalent expended by an individual while seated at rest
evidence.location: Table 1 (Glossary of terms), row "Metabolic equivalent of task (MET)"
evidence.supports: def（倍數是和「安靜坐著休息」相比）

evidence.quote: Moderate-intensity activities have a MET value of 3 to 5.9 METs; vigorous-intensity activities have a MET value of 6 or greater.
evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Physical Activity Intensity
evidence.supports: def（與 WHO 範圍一致）

evidence.quote: Examples of moderate-intensity activities (defined using absolute intensity) include walking briskly at 2.5 to 4.0 mph, playing volleyball, or raking the yard.
evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Physical Activity Intensity
evidence.supports: example（快走、打排球、用耙子整理庭院）

evidence.quote: Generally, a person doing moderate-intensity aerobic activity can talk, but not sing, during the activity.
evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Physical Activity Intensity ("talk test")
evidence.supports: note（說話測試）

evidence.quote: perceived exertion levels of 5 or 6 on a 0–10 scale
evidence.supports: def（5–6分；本站 SL-3.T 所引來源）

evidence.quote: Moderate-intensity physical activity, as defined by the WHO, involves activities performed at 3–5 times the intensity of rest
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes（此處倍數與 WHO 原文不同）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text or abstract, Tier 1–2)
entries.reviewer_notes: WHO 2020 表1：3 至 <6 METs、自覺費力 5–6 分；美國身體活動指引：3–5.9 METs，兩者一致。注意：本站 SL-3.T 所引 2024 國際共識（Blaess）把 WHO 定義寫成「3–5 times the intensity of rest」，與 WHO 原文（3 至 <6）略有出入；本詞條採 WHO 原文。5–6 分三者一致。WHO 原文「rating scale of perceived exertion scale of 0–10」中 scale 重複為原文如此。例子與說話測試出自美國身體活動指引（JAMA 2018 摘要論文）。

entries.def: 活動時消耗的能量達安靜坐著時的6倍以上；若用0–10分評估自己有多費力，約在7–8分或以上。
entries.example: 慢跑或跑步、提很重的購物袋、上激烈的健身課
entries.note: 簡單判斷：做高強度活動時，通常說不到幾個字就得停下來換氣。

evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Physical Activity Intensity
evidence.supports: def（「7–8分或以上」）

evidence.quote: Examples of vigorous-intensity activities include jogging or running, carrying heavy groceries, or participating in a strenuous fitness class.

evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Physical Activity Intensity ("talk test")
evidence.supports: note（說話測試）

entries.reviewer_notes: 本站「激烈運動」「高強度的激烈運動」出現在發作期建議（AS-1.T 引 TRA 2020、AS-M1 引 EULAR 2021、RA-1.5 引 EULAR 2025）；依既有研究筆記，這些指引用的是 high-intensity／intense strenuous 等字眼，並未給 MET 定義（本組未逐一重查原文）。本詞條以 WHO 2020 的正式定義說明，是最接近的正式定義。WHO 寫「usually a 7 or 8」，美國指引寫「begins at a level of 7 or 8」，故寫「約在7–8分或以上」。

evidence.location: Key Concepts for the Physical Activity Guidelines > Physical Activity Intensity
evidence.supports: example（做輕鬆家事）；note（取代久坐有好處）

evidence.quote: Multicomponent physical activity are activities that can be done at home or in a structured group or class setting and combine all types of exercise (aerobic, muscle strengthening and balance training) into a session, and this has been shown to be effective. An example of a multicomponent physical activity programme could include walking (aerobic activity), lifting weights (muscle strengthening) and could incorporate balance training. Examples of balance training can include walking backwards or sideways or standing on one foot while doing an upper body muscle-strengthening activity, such as bicep curls. Dancing also combines aerobic and balance components.

The site uses 物理治療師 for both NICE's 'specialist physiotherapist' and ACR's 'physical therapist'; the research notes record that ASAS-EULAR changed 'physical therapy' to 'physiotherapy' in its 2022 update (research/axspa.md C42), i.e. the two words are used for the same intervention. The site also uses 物理治療師 in axspa-exercise-sum, which is not in the context file. 查核後修訂：原補充（物理治療有助改善脊椎活動、體能與疼痛）引自 2008 年 Cochrane 回顧的背景句，不是研究結論；2019 年 Cochrane 回顧對脊椎活動度的效果仍不確定，所以刪除補充。

entries.def: 自我管理是自己處理症狀、治療、生活習慣改變，以及疾病對心理與社會影響的能力；自我管理課程是引導您做到這些的標準化課程。
entries.example: 課程可包括疾病衛教、學習解決問題和設定目標
entries.note: 自我管理不是要您獨自面對，最好有醫療人員、病友團體和家人支持。

evidence.quote: self-management is defined as ‘the ability of the individual to manage symptoms, treatment, lifestyle changes and psychosocial and cultural consequences of health conditions’
evidence.supports: def: 自我管理的能力

evidence.quote: In this definition, two major components were highlighted: (1) self-management is aimed at achieving independence and (2) ideally, self-management should be supported by others, for example, HCPs, patient organisations and family.
evidence.supports: note

evidence.quote: R2. Patient education should be the start point and underpin all self-management interventions.
evidence.supports: example: 疾病衛教

evidence.quote: R3. Self-management interventions that include problem solving and goal setting and, where relevant to the individual and available, cognitive behavioural therapy should be incorporated into routine clinical practice to support patients.
evidence.supports: example: 解決問題、設定目標

evidence.quote: Use of a standardized self-management program is conditionally recommended over no standardized self-management program.
evidence.supports: def: 標準化課程; context: site sentence RA-5.3

evidence.quote: Standardized program to guide self-management.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Self-management program [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 幫助您做到自我管理的標準化課程 (2 passes; the row continues with named example programmes, not used)

evidence.quote: The concept of self-management to some may imply needing to deal alone with a chronic condition.
evidence.supports: note（自我管理不是要您獨自面對）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text or abstract, Tier 1–2)
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: EULAR 2021 definition and ACR 2022 'standardized self-management program' are PMC-verified; Table 1 wording (WebFetch) is supplementary. EULAR's definition also mentions 'cultural consequences'; the def says 心理與社會影響 for readability (a simplification, nothing added). EULAR 2021 is not cited on the site; it was used because it gives an explicit definition. ACR Table 1 names specific US programmes (e.g. Arthritis Self-Management Program); these were not used because they may not be available in Taiwan.

entries.def: 職業重建是幫助克服就業阻礙、支持就業的訓練課程，適合目前有工作或想要工作的人。
entries.note: 指引也建議評估並調整工作場所的環境和工作內容，以維護安全和健康。

evidence.supports: def: 支持就業的訓練課程；適合有工作或想工作的人

evidence.supports: note: 評估並調整工作場所

evidence.quote: Evaluating and adjusting work-site conditions and duties for safety and well-being.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Work site evaluation and modifications [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]

ACR based this recommendation on an 'absence of evidence for vocational rehabilitation'. Its implementation notes refer to US law (Americans with Disabilities Act, Family and Medical Leave Act) and do not apply to Taiwan. 職業重建 is the Taiwanese service term (as recorded in ra.json reviewer_notes); no source describes the Taiwanese service itself.

entries.def: 脊椎扳動手法是一種徒手治療：在脊椎關節活動範圍的末端快速、小幅度地用力一推，常會發出「喀」一聲；整脊也屬於這類手法。
entries.note: 曾有病例報告：脊椎已融合或嚴重脊椎骨質疏鬆的人整脊後（尤其是頸部）發生脊椎骨折、脊髓受傷，甚至癱瘓。

evidence.quote: In this review, we consider SMT to represent any hands-on treatment of the spine, including both mobilisation and manipulation.
evidence.supports: def: 徒手治療

evidence.quote: manipulation uses a high velocity impulse or thrust applied to a synovial joint over a short amplitude at or near the end of the passive or physiological range of motion
evidence.supports: def: 在關節活動範圍末端快速、小幅度地推

evidence.quote: This is often accompanied by an audible crack, resulting from cavitation of the joint.
evidence.supports: def: 常會發出喀一聲

evidence.quote: the panel recommended strongly against spinal manipulation with high-velocity thrusts in patients with AS who have spinal fusion or advanced spinal osteoporosis.
evidence.supports: def: high-velocity thrust; context: site sentence AS-3.2

evidence.quote: Several case reports of spine fractures, spinal cord injury, and paraplegia following chiropractic spinal manipulation, particularly of the cervical spine in patients with spinal fusion or advanced osteoporosis of the spine, have been reported
evidence.supports: def: 整脊屬於這類手法; note（病例報告：骨折、脊髓受傷、癱瘓；尤其頸部）

evidence.quote: this recommendation for “not” using chiropractic therapy (i.e., chiropractic spinal adjustment) directly for the management of RA is conditional because of the potential cervical spine complications that can occur in people with RA
evidence.supports: def: 整脊（脊椎調整）; context: site myth RA-M4

evidence.quote: Diagnosis and manipulation of malaligned joints, particularly the spine.
evidence.location: Table 1 (Descriptions and examples of interventions), row: Chiropractic [WebFetch of the PMC table page pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10947582/table/T1/; the get_full_text_article output omits Table 1]
evidence.supports: def: 整脊是對脊椎等關節的扳動 (2 passes)

evidence.quote: However, any type of spinal manipulation should be avoided in axSpA patients due to the risk of osteoporosis and spinal fracture, and rheumatologists should expressly warn patients of the risk involved
evidence.supports: context: site sentence AS-3.1

entries.aka: spinal manipulation (high-velocity thrust); chiropractic spinal manipulation / chiropractic spinal adjustment
entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: all quotes PMC-verified, but the technical description (end of range, audible crack) comes from a BMJ systematic review (Tier 3); 'high-velocity thrust' and the note are Tier 1 (ACR 2015). Rubinstein's 'SMT' covers both manipulation and the gentler mobilisation; 扳動手法 corresponds to manipulation (high-velocity thrust), which is what ACR 2015 recommends against. Scope differs by source: ACR 2015 strongly against only with spinal fusion or advanced spinal osteoporosis; TRA 2020 says avoid any spinal manipulation in axSpA; ACR 2022 conditionally against chiropractic for RA (the PMC text drops the word 'against' from the statement, but 'not' is retained in the rationale quoted here). The PMC text of the TRA sentence ends '...techniques common in.' (word lost), so it was quoted only up to 'risk involved'. The 2019 BMJ review is about chronic low back pain; it is used only for the technical description of manipulation.

entries.def: 頸椎牽引是用拉力伸展頸部的治療。例如機械牽引：把頭套套在後腦（有時也套住下巴）並接上機器，依設定的時間和重量拉。
entries.note: 僵直性脊椎炎患者的脊椎常較脆弱，台灣共識建議避免頸椎牽引。
entries.label: 系統性回顧・說明

sources.short: Cochrane 2008 頸部機械牽引系統性回顧
sources.citation: Graham N, et al. Mechanical traction for neck pain with or without radiculopathy. Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2008;(3):CD006408.

evidence.quote: Mechanical traction 'stretches' the neck. With the patient lying on their back, a head halter is placed under the back of the head and possibly the jaw and attached to a machine. The machine is set for a certain time period and specific weight for the pulling action to occur.
evidence.location: Plain language summary (PMC record of the Cochrane review)
evidence.supports: def (all parts)

evidence.quote: AS patients often have fragile and osteoporotic spines that can develop spinal fractures or dislocations from only mild trauma, and therefore contact sports, cervical traction, and spinal manipulation should be avoided.
evidence.supports: note; context: site sentence AS-3.1

entries.aka: cervical traction (e.g., mechanical traction of the neck)
entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: def from a Cochrane review record in PMC (Tier 3); note PMC-verified (TRA 2020, Tier 1). The Cochrane description covers mechanical traction only; TRA advises avoiding cervical traction in general, so the def gives mechanical traction as an example. Cochrane 2008 (search to March 2008). It also lists side effects ('headache, nausea, fainting and injury to tissue'), which were not added.

entries.def: 接觸性運動是指比賽中本來就預期選手之間會有身體接觸的運動。
entries.example: 籃球、足球
entries.note: 僵直性脊椎炎的脊椎常較脆弱，輕微外力就可能骨折，台灣共識建議避免。
entries.label: 文獻回顧・定義

sources.short: 2021 接觸性運動與抗凝血治療回顧（J Investig Med）
sources.citation: Kichloo A, et al. Anticoagulation and antiplatelet therapy in contact sports: is it career limiting? J Investig Med 2021;69(3):781-784.

sources.short: 台灣 TRA 2020 中軸型脊椎關節炎共識（台灣的風濕病醫學會）
sources.citation: Wei JC, et al. Taiwan Rheumatology Association consensus recommendations for the management of axial spondyloarthritis. Int J Rheum Dis 2020;23(1):7-23.

evidence.quote: Contact sports are defined as sports in which body-to-body contact is expected as part of the game such as football, basketball, soccer and hockey.
evidence.supports: def and example (basketball, soccer)

evidence.quote: AS patients often have fragile and osteoporotic spines that can develop spinal fractures or dislocations from only mild trauma, and therefore contact sports, cervical traction, and spinal manipulation should be avoided.
evidence.supports: note; context: site sentences AS-3.1 and AS-M1

entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: explicit definition only in a narrative review abstract (Tier 3, mid-tier journal); note PMC-verified (TRA 2020). No guideline or consensus definition was found in accessible PubMed text. The AAP policy statement 'Medical conditions affecting sports participation' (Rice SG, Pediatrics 2008;121:841-8, PMID 18381550) classifies sports as collision, contact and limited-contact, but its abstract has no definition and the full text was not accessible. 'football' in the quote probably means American football and 'hockey' is ambiguous, so the example uses only basketball and soccer. The site's 容易碰撞的接觸性運動 fits this definition.

entries.def: 發作計畫是和醫療團隊討論後，依您的需要、偏好和生活情況擬定的「病情發作時怎麼辦」計畫。
entries.example: 內容可包括聯絡誰、自我照護、疼痛與疲倦處理，以及醫療團隊說明的可能藥物調整
entries.note: 自我照護例如運動、伸展和關節保護；也包括如何處理發作對日常生活和工作的影響。
entries.label: NICE 2017・建議內容

sources.short: NICE NG65 脊椎關節炎診斷與治療指引（英國的國家臨床指引機構）
sources.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE). Spondyloarthritis in over 16s: diagnosis and management (NICE guideline NG65). London: NICE; 2017 (published 28 February 2017; last updated 2 June 2017).

evidence.quote: Consider developing a flare management plan that is tailored to the person's individual needs, preferences and circumstances.
evidence.supports: def (2 passes this session; matches research/axspa.md C60)

evidence.quote: When discussing any flare management plan, provide information on:
evidence.supports: def: 和醫療團隊討論 (confirmed verbatim on a second pass; matches research/axspa.md C60)

evidence.quote: access to care during flares (including details of a named person to contact [for example, a specialist rheumatology nurse]); self-care (for example, exercises, stretching and joint protection); pain and fatigue management; potential changes to medicines; managing the impact on daily life and ability to work.
evidence.supports: example and note (bullets returned verbatim this session; matches research/axspa.md C60)

entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: Tier 1 guideline cited by the site, read via WebFetch (2 passes, matching the research-phase reading); PubMed record not retrievable by get_article_metadata. No PubMed abstract or PMC text defines a flare plan; NICE NG65 is the only source. PubMed indexes NG65 as a book record: PMID 28350428 found by title search and confirmed as a 2017 NICE spondyloarthritis record by field searches, but get_article_metadata returned nothing and there is no DOI. A second 2017 NICE spondyloarthritis record, PMID 32049469, also exists; please confirm which is the guideline. NICE's example contact (a specialist rheumatology nurse) is UK-specific and was omitted.

entries.def: 普林是身體本來就有、很多食物也含有的物質；身體分解普林，最後會變成尿酸。高普林食物就是普林含量高的食物。
entries.example: 肉類、內臟、肉汁、海鮮等。
entries.note: 尿酸大多來自身體本身的普林；動物來源的高普林食物，普林量通常比植物來源的高。
entries.label: 文獻回顧・定義

sources.short: Keenan 2020 尿酸生物學回顧
sources.citation: Keenan RT. The biology of urate. Semin Arthritis Rheum 2020;50(3S):S2-S10.

sources.short: Jamnik 2016 果糖與痛風系統性回顧
sources.citation: Jamnik J et al. Fructose intake and risk of gout and hyperuricemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies. BMJ Open 2016;6(10):e013191.

sources.short: Zhang 2012 高普林食物與痛風復發研究
sources.citation: Zhang Y et al. Purine-rich foods intake and recurrent gout attacks. Ann Rheum Dis 2012;71(9):1448-53.

sources.short: ACR 2020 痛風治療指引
sources.citation: FitzGerald JD et al. 2020 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Management of Gout. Arthritis Care Res (Hoboken) 2020;72(6):744-760.

evidence.quote: Urate is the end-product of the purine metabolism in humans. The dominant source of urate is endogenous purines and the remainder comes through diet.
evidence.supports: def：分解普林最後變成尿酸；普林有身體本身與飲食兩種來源。note：尿酸大多來自身體本身的普林。

evidence.quote: Hyperuricemia or excessive circulating concentrations of urate, the final product of purine metabolism, is a major risk factor for gout and plays a major role in the pathogenesis of this condition.
evidence.supports: def：尿酸（urate）是普林代謝的最終產物。

evidence.quote: The food items included all high-purine content of foods (eg, all meats, organ meats, meat extracts and gravies, seafood, beans, peas, lentils, oatmeal, spinach, asparagus, mushroom, yeast, beer and other alcoholic beverages (including wine and liquor))
evidence.supports: example：研究列為高普林食物的肉類、內臟、肉汁（meat extracts and gravies）、海鮮（清單也含植物性食物與酒，見 reviewer_notes）。

evidence.quote: indicate that avoiding or reducing purine-rich foods, especially of animal origin (that tend to have higher purine content than those of plant origin), would help reduce recurrent gout attacks.
evidence.supports: note：動物來源的高普林食物，普林量通常比植物來源高。

evidence.quote: Limiting purine intake is conditionally recommended for patients with gout, regardless of disease activity.
evidence.location: Results – Management of lifestyle factors (recommendation statements)
evidence.supports: 網站用法（GT-2.1 限制普林攝取）。

entries.confidence: Medium (Tier 3: review abstract, SR and cohort PMC full text; no Tier 1 guideline defines 'purine')
entries.reviewer_notes: ACR 2020, EULAR 2016 and BSR 2017 use 'purine intake / high purine foods' without defining purine; the definition therefore rests on a review (Keenan 2020, single author, Semin Arthritis Rheum supplement) and Jamnik 2016. Zhang 2012's list of 'high-purine content' foods also includes beans, peas, lentils, oatmeal, spinach, asparagus, mushroom, yeast, beer and other alcoholic beverages; the example deliberately lists only the animal foods so that it does not appear to contradict GT-2.4 (soy beans and vegetable protein encouraged) — Zhang found plant purines only weakly associated with attacks. Physician may prefer to show the full list with that caveat.

entries.def: 尿酸是身體分解普林後最後產生的物質。血中尿酸濃度太高，叫做高尿酸血症，是發生痛風最重要的危險因子。
entries.note: 美國痛風指引：血中尿酸6.8 mg/dL以上，但從未發作、也沒有痛風石，稱為無症狀高尿酸血症。
entries.label: 文獻回顧與 ACR 2020・定義

sources.short: Jamnik 2016 果糖與痛風系統性回顧
sources.citation: Jamnik J et al. Fructose intake and risk of gout and hyperuricemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies. BMJ Open 2016;6(10):e013191.

sources.short: Keenan 2020 尿酸生物學回顧
sources.citation: Keenan RT. The biology of urate. Semin Arthritis Rheum 2020;50(3S):S2-S10.

sources.short: Dalbeth 2021 Lancet 痛風回顧
sources.citation: Dalbeth N et al. Gout. Lancet 2021;397(10287):1843-1855.

sources.short: ACR 2020 痛風治療指引
sources.citation: FitzGerald JD et al. 2020 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Management of Gout. Arthritis Care Res (Hoboken) 2020;72(6):744-760.

evidence.quote: Hyperuricemia or excessive circulating concentrations of urate, the final product of purine metabolism, is a major risk factor for gout and plays a major role in the pathogenesis of this condition.
evidence.supports: def：尿酸是普林代謝的最終產物；高尿酸血症＝血中尿酸濃度過高，是痛風的主要危險因子。

evidence.quote: Urate is the end-product of the purine metabolism in humans.
evidence.supports: def：尿酸是人體普林代謝的最終產物。

evidence.quote: Increased concentration of serum urate (hyperuricaemia) is the most important risk factor for the development of gout.
evidence.supports: def：血中尿酸濃度升高（高尿酸血症）是發生痛風最重要的危險因子。

evidence.quote: Recommendations in this guideline apply to patients with gout, except for a single recommendation regarding the use of ULT in individuals with asymptomatic hyperuricemia, which is defined as an SU concentration of ≥6.8 mg/dl with no prior gout flares or subcutaneous tophi.
evidence.supports: note：ACR 對無症狀高尿酸血症的定義（SU ≥6.8 mg/dl，且無痛風發作或皮下痛風石）。

evidence.quote: Gout flare and serum urate (SU) concentration (and tophus for PICO question 1) were specified as critical outcomes for all PICO questions specific to ULT.
evidence.supports: alias「血中尿酸」＝ serum urate (SU)。

entries.aka: uric acid / urate; serum urate (SU); hyperuricemia (hyperuricaemia)
entries.confidence: High (Tier 1 ACR 2020 PMC full text for the hyperuricemia threshold; definition of uric acid from Tier 3 SR/review, PMC full text and abstracts)
entries.reviewer_notes: Sources use 'urate' and 'uric acid' interchangeably; both are 尿酸 in plain Chinese. The 6.8 mg/dl threshold in ACR 2020 is given specifically for 'asymptomatic hyperuricemia' (no prior flares or tophi), so the note is worded that way rather than as a general cut-off. The Taiwan 2018 consensus (site S8, abstract only) was not checked for its own hyperuricemia threshold; if it differs, the physician may prefer the local definition.

entries.def: 高果糖玉米糖漿是由果糖和葡萄糖組成的液體甜味劑，用來取代一般砂糖（蔗糖），例如加在含糖飲料裡。

sources.short: White 2008 高果糖玉米糖漿回顧
sources.citation: White JS. Straight talk about high-fructose corn syrup: what it is and what it ain't. Am J Clin Nutr 2008;88(6):1716S-1721S.

sources.short: Jamnik 2016 果糖與痛風系統性回顧
sources.citation: Jamnik J et al. Fructose intake and risk of gout and hyperuricemia: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies. BMJ Open 2016;6(10):e013191.

evidence.quote: In light of the recent emergence of new therapeutics for rheumatoid arthritis, such as kinase inhibitors and biosimilars, a new nomenclature for disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs), which are currently often classified as synthetic (or chemical) DMARDs (sDMARDS) and biological DMARDs (bDMARDs), may be needed.

entries.reviewer_notes: On the site, 抗風濕藥物 (CM-5.1) translates EULAR 2019 "DMARDs". The EULAR RA 2025 update (PMID 41826212, abstract) supersedes the 2022 update and keeps the same cs/b/ts DMARD categories. evidence.quote: Strong recommendations included initiation of ULT for all patients with tophaceous gout, radiographic damage due to gout, or frequent gout flares; allopurinol as the preferred first-line ULT, including for those with moderate-to-severe chronic kidney disease (CKD; stage ≥3); using a low starting dose of allopurinol (≤100 mg/day, and lower in CKD) or febuxostat (≤40 mg/day); and a treat-to-target management strategy with ULT dose titration guided by serial serum urate (SU) measurements, with an SU target of <6 mg/dl.
evidence.supports: def: 依抽血尿酸值調整劑量；example: allopurinol、febuxostat

evidence.quote: there was high certainty of evidence regarding the efficacy of ULT in reducing flare frequency
evidence.supports: def: 減少痛風發作

evidence.quote: Continuing ULT indefinitely over stopping ULT is conditionally recommended.
evidence.supports: def: 指引建議長期持續使用

evidence.quote: When initiating ULT, concomitant antiinflammatory prophylaxis therapy for a duration of at least 3–6 months was strongly recommended.
evidence.supports: note: 同時使用至少3到6個月的預防發作藥物

evidence.quote: A lower starting dose of any ULT reduces the risk of flare associated with initiation
evidence.location: Results, "Recommendations for choice of initial ULT"
evidence.supports: note: 剛開始吃可能誘發發作

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text or abstract, Tier 1–2)
entries.reviewer_notes: The "Continuing ULT indefinitely" sentence has no glued words. Its direction ("over stopping") was also confirmed by the 2023 Korean guideline in the research notes (gout.md C97). The serum urate target (<6 mg/dl, abstract) is left out of the def on purpose. Site GT-4.4 (keep taking ULT during a flare) rests on BSR 2017 and was not re-checked here.

entries.def: 痛風發作時用來壓下關節發炎和疼痛的藥，第一線是 colchicine（秋水仙素）、消炎止痛藥（NSAIDs）或類固醇；發作後及早使用效果較好。

evidence.supports: def: 發作後及早使用效果較好

entries.def: 非活性疫苗是不含活病原的疫苗（相對於活性減毒疫苗）；風濕病患者即使正在使用類固醇或抗風濕藥物，也可以安全接種。
entries.example: 肺炎鏈球菌疫苗、B型肝炎疫苗、重組帶狀疱疹疫苗
entries.note: 部分藥物會讓疫苗反應變弱（但通常不會完全沒效）；如果可以，最好在開始免疫抑制治療前接種。

entries.reviewer_notes: No PubMed-accessible source this session gave a component-based definition (inactivated, subunit, toxoid, recombinant, etc.); 「不含活病原」 is the literal meaning of "non-live" as set against "live-attenuated" in EULAR 2019/2021. The Brazilian SBR 2025 guideline uses "inactivated vaccines" for this group (it includes the recombinant zoster and pneumococcal vaccines). Influenza is not used as an unqualified example because ACR notes live influenza vaccines have "inactivated alternatives". ACR exception: rituximab blunts responses strongly ("other than rituximab"). The site's CM-5.1 rests on the EULAR 2019 full text "during the use of glucocorticoids and DMARDs" (research-phase WebFetch); the abstract quote ("regardless of underlying therapy") supports the same point.

entries.def: 活性減毒疫苗含有活的、但已減弱的病原；正在使用免疫抑制藥物的人接種後，可能被疫苗裡的病原感染，所以通常建議延後或謹慎接種。

entries.note: 有些活性疫苗另有非活性版本，可安全給使用免疫抑制藥物的人；接種前請先問風濕科醫師。

evidence.supports: def: 晚上使用眼藥膏 (expert practice)

entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: The main EULAR 2020 sentence (thicker than artificial tears; overnight relief; blurred vision; morning lid hygiene) is not in the PubMed abstract, and EULAR 2020 has no PMC version. It was read via WebFetch in the research phase (3 consistent passes; sjogren.md C08). Re-confirmed by the verifier on 2026-10-07 (2 WebFetch passes of the publisher page, identical wording); still not machine-checkable. BSR 2025 (PMC) independently supports night-time ointment use and vitamin A ointments. No PubMed-accessible text was found that states the blurred-vision point.

entries.def: DHEA（dehydroepiandrosterone）是腎上腺分泌的一種荷爾蒙，身體可把它轉變成男性和女性荷爾蒙；也有口服的 DHEA 補充劑。
entries.note: 研究回顧發現，DHEA 用於乾燥症的結果令人失望；副作用多為輕微的長痘痘和多毛。

evidence.supports: def: 腎上腺分泌的荷爾蒙；可轉變成男性和女性荷爾蒙

evidence.supports: def: 腎上腺荷爾蒙；用於風濕病結果有爭議

evidence.supports: def: 口服 DHEA 補充劑

evidence.supports: note: 用於乾燥症的結果令人失望

evidence.quote: Side effects were uncommon; most of them were androgenic effects such as acne and hirsutism, which were considered mild.
evidence.supports: note: 副作用多為輕微的長痘痘和多毛

evidence.quote: In SS, the five studies encompassed 240 individuals, all females, and showed modest results.
evidence.supports: site usage SJ-M3 (5 studies, 240 women)

evidence.supports: site usage SJ-M3 (no difference vs placebo)

entries.reviewer_notes: Skare 2023 is a systematic review without meta-analysis in a smaller journal (Tier 3 under this protocol). It is the source the site already cites, and BSR 2025 (PMC) independently describes DHEA as "a testosterone precursor". Confidence Medium because the definition rests on a Tier-3 systematic review. No Chinese chemical name is given because no source supplies one.

entries.def: 紫外線指數是國際通用、表示陽光中紫外線強弱的簡單數字；數字越高，紫外線越強，用來提醒民眾採取適當的防曬。
entries.note: 指數會受太陽高度、雲量、臭氧量、雪地反射等因素影響。
entries.label: 文獻・定義（WHO 指數）

sources.short: Lehmann 2019 紫外線指數認知系統性回顧計畫書
sources.citation: Lehmann M et al. The extent of public awareness, understanding and use of the Global Solar UV index as a worldwide health promotion instrument to improve sun protection: protocol for a systematic review. BMJ Open 2019;9(7):e028092.

evidence.quote: The Global Solar Ultraviolet Index (UVI) was introduced by the WHO and partner organisations in 1995 as a simple measure of the intensity of solar UV radiation, providing guidance for the population to use appropriate sun protective measures.
evidence.supports: def：WHO 等機構推出、表示陽光紫外線強度的簡單數值，引導民眾採取適當防曬。

evidence.quote: The index was adopted as a standard indicator of UV levels by the World Meteorological Organization and World Health Organization in 1994.
evidence.supports: def：國際通用（WMO 與 WHO 採用的標準指標）。

evidence.quote: Forecasts of UV Index values are now widely available and are intended to be used by the public as a guide to avoid excessive exposure to UV radiation.
evidence.supports: def：預報供民眾參考，以避免過度曝曬。

evidence.quote: Factors affecting the UV Index, such as the sun elevation, total amount of ozone in the atmosphere, cloud cover, reflection from snow and local pollution, are also discussed.
evidence.supports: note：影響指數的因素（太陽高度、臭氧、雲量、雪地反射、局部污染）。

evidence.quote: According to the World Health Organization and partner organizations, no protection against ultraviolet (UV) radiation is required on days with "low" values (i.e., values <3) of the Global Solar Ultraviolet Index (UVI).
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：WHO 等機構認為指數 <3 時不需防護（網站 SL-1.T 以 3 為門檻）。

evidence.quote: Conversely, sun exposure on days with rounded UVI values of 2 can indeed provide doses sufficient to induce erythema in skin type II after two hours around noon.
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：指數 2 的日子中午約 2 小時，第 II 型膚色也可能曬出紅斑。

entries.aka: UV Index (Global Solar UV Index, UVI)
entries.confidence: Medium (PubMed-indexed descriptions of the WHO index in abstracts; the WHO 2002 practical guide itself is not PubMed-indexed)
entries.reviewer_notes: The sources disagree on the year (Fioletov: adopted by WMO and WHO in 1994; Lehmann: introduced by WHO and partners in 1995), so no year is given. The site's CM-6.1 wording (higher index → more skin/eye damage, less time to harm) comes from the WHO Q&A web page, not a PubMed source; it is consistent with this entry. Possible caution for the lupus pages: Lehmann 2019 (Photochem Photobiol) found that on UVI 2 days about two hours around noon can produce erythema in skin type II, i.e. the WHO '<3 = no protection' band is not harmless for everyone; physician may add this for photosensitive patients. Organisation names as printed in the abstracts: 'World Health Organization', 'World Meteorological Organization'.

entries.def: 光敏感是指皮膚對陽光有不尋常的反應，例如曬太陽後出現皮疹。紅斑性狼瘡的這類皮疹，常在曬後幾天到幾週才出現。
entries.note: 有些人曬太陽後，也會出現疲倦、關節痛等全身症狀。
entries.label: ACR 標準・定義

sources.short: Kim 2013 皮膚型狼瘡光敏感回顧
sources.citation: Kim A, Chong BF. Photosensitivity in cutaneous lupus erythematosus. Photodermatol Photoimmunol Photomed 2013;29(1):4-11.

evidence.supports: def：ACR 定義＝對陽光有不尋常反應而出現的皮疹。

evidence.quote: Whether noted from patient history or physician observation, photosensitivity remains one of the 11 diagnostic criteria for SLE as determined by the 1982 American College of Rheumatology (ACR) guidelines
evidence.supports: 背景：光敏感是 1982 年 ACR 紅斑性狼瘡標準之一（依病史或醫師觀察）。

evidence.quote: Thus, because patients may not consider flares that occur days to weeks after extended sun exposure, we encourage providers to ask patients about flares that happen up to three weeks after being outside for an extended period.
evidence.supports: def：皮疹可在曬後幾天到幾週才出現。

evidence.quote: Detecting photosensitivity may be limited by a potential lag period of several weeks between sun exposure and skin lesions
evidence.supports: def／網站 SL-M3：曬太陽與皮膚病灶之間可能相隔數週，因此不易察覺。

evidence.quote: Photosensitivity covers not only skin disease flares but also systemic symptoms such as fatigue and arthralgias
evidence.supports: note：光敏感也包括疲倦、關節痛等全身症狀。

evidence.quote: several photoprovocation studies have clearly demonstrated that the onset of true photosensitive reactions is often delayed
evidence.supports: def（皮疹常延遲出現）

entries.confidence: Medium (ACR criteria definition quoted in a Tier 3 PMC review; delayed onset confirmed by Tier 1 BSR 2026 PMC full text)
entries.reviewer_notes: The original 1982 ACR criteria paper was not accessed; the ACR definition is taken from Kim & Chong's quotation of it. Kim & Chong call the 1982 ACR criteria 'diagnostic criteria' (they are classification criteria), note that the ACR wording is broad and can capture other light-induced rashes (e.g. polymorphous light eruption), and propose their own (unvalidated) definition. 'American College of Rheumatology' is the organisation's full name as printed in its own PubMed-indexed guidelines (e.g. FitzGerald 2020).

entries.def: 免疫系統的重要工作，是分辨「自己」和「外來的東西」。自體免疫是指出現了針對自己身體的免疫成分（例如自體抗體）；若同時造成明顯的病變，就是自體免疫疾病。
entries.example: 紅斑性狼瘡就是一種自體免疫疾病。
entries.note: 自體抗體也可能出現在健康的人身上；單憑自體抗體，不能診斷自體免疫疾病。

evidence.quote: Autoimmunity can be considered as the presence of self-reactive adaptive immune components, and autoimmune diseases can be thought of as autoimmunity plus clinically apparent pathology
evidence.supports: def：自體免疫＝出現針對自己的免疫成分；自體免疫疾病＝自體免疫再加上明顯病變

evidence.quote: Autoimmunity is characterized by self-reactive immune components and autoimmune disease by autoimmunity plus pathology.
evidence.supports: def：同上（摘要版）

evidence.quote: While autoantibodies alone are not diagnostic for disease, they do define the presence of autoimmunity.
evidence.supports: def：「例如自體抗體」；自體抗體代表有自體免疫，但單獨不等於疾病

evidence.quote: The critical function of the immune system is to discriminate self from non-self.
evidence.supports: def：免疫系統本來會分辨「自己」和「外來的東西」（non-self 意譯）

evidence.quote: The basic tests include a differential blood count, CRP and/or ESR (to rule out severe systemic disease, as an indicator for parasitic disease, eosinophilic count, autoimmune disease such as systemic lupus), in all patients.
evidence.supports: example：「autoimmune disease such as systemic lupus」→紅斑性狼瘡是自體免疫疾病

evidence.quote: To update the European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR) recommendations for vaccination in adult patients with autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases (AIIRD) published in 2011.
evidence.supports: alias「自體免疫風濕病」對應 EULAR 的 autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases (AIIRD)（僅名稱，摘要未定義）

evidence.quote: Although proposals have been made regarding approaches to define autoimmunity and specific autoimmune diseases, there are still no commonly agreed upon general criteria for these
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：目前沒有公認的自體免疫通用判定標準

evidence.quote: Antibodies against self-antigens are also found in cancer, during massive tissue damage and even in healthy subjects.
evidence.supports: note（健康的人也可能有自體抗體）

entries.aka: autoimmunity; autoimmune disease; autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases (AIIRD)
entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: No Tier 1–2 consensus definition of 'autoimmunity' was found; Miller 2023 itself says there are 'still no commonly agreed upon general criteria'. The definition therefore rests on two reviews (Miller 2023, PMC full text + abstract; Lleo 2010, abstract), hence Medium confidence. 'non-self' is rendered as 「外來的東西」 (plain approximation). 'self-reactive' is rendered as 「針對自己身體」 rather than 'attack', which no quote uses. Alias 自體免疫風濕病 = EULAR 2019 'autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases (AIIRD)'; the EULAR abstract names the group but does not list its diseases, so the entry explains only the general concept. The example (紅斑性狼瘡) rests on S1's phrase 'autoimmune disease such as systemic lupus', which sits in a sentence about routine blood tests in CSU; the site's SLE page is titled 紅斑性狼瘡. Site wording UR-3.1/UR-M1 「慢性蕁麻疹主要和自體免疫有關」 matches S1 ('CU is predominantly an autoimmune condition'); the '>50%' autoimmune-mechanism figure in the note applies to CSU (自發型), as worded. 查核後修訂：此詞條也連結在疫苗卡片（CM-5.1），原補充（慢性蕁麻疹主要和自體免疫有關、超過一半自發型和自體抗體有關，GALEN 2026 §3.3、§4）放在那裡離題，改為兩頁都適用的說明；蕁麻疹頁的 UR-3.1 本身已寫明慢性蕁麻疹和自體免疫有關。

entries.term: 自發型與誘發型蕁麻疹
entries.def: 慢性蕁麻疹（超過6週）分兩型：自發型的膨疹或腫脹會自己冒出來，沒有明確的誘發因子；誘發型則是碰到足夠強的特定誘發因子（如冷、皮膚受壓、陽光）才發作。
entries.example: 誘發型例如寒冷性、延遲性壓力性、日光性、膽鹼性蕁麻疹。
entries.note: 兩型可能同時存在；自發型也可能因壓力或感染而加重。

evidence.quote: Urticaria is classified based on two main criteria: (i) its duration, as acute or chronic, and (ii) the role of definite triggers, categorized as inducible or spontaneous
evidence.supports: def：依有無明確誘發因子分為誘發型與自發型

evidence.quote: Spontaneous appearance of wheals, angioedema or both for > 6 weeks
evidence.location: Table 6 (CSU column); quoted only up to '> 6 weeks' because the next word is glued in the PMC extraction
evidence.supports: def：自發型＝膨疹或腫脹自己出現、超過6週

evidence.quote: Chronic urticaria (CU) is either spontaneous or inducible, lasts >6 weeks and persists for >1 year in most patients.
evidence.supports: def：慢性蕁麻疹分自發型或誘發型，超過6週

evidence.quote: In contrast to chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU), chronic inducible urticaria (CIndU) has definite and subtype-specific triggers that induce signs and symptoms.
evidence.supports: def：誘發型有明確、各亞型特有的誘發因子；自發型沒有

evidence.quote: Inducible urticaria is characterized by the presence of definite and subtype‐specific triggers leading to the development of wheals, angioedema, or both
evidence.supports: def：誘發型由明確、特定的誘發因子引起膨疹或腫脹

evidence.quote: These triggers are definite because the symptoms always appear when the trigger at the individual threshold level is present and never when the trigger is absent.
evidence.supports: def：「碰到足夠強的（達個人門檻）誘發因子才發作」

evidence.quote: These triggers are specific because each subtype of inducible urticaria has its own relevant trigger, such as exposure to cold in cold urticaria, and this trigger is not relevant in other forms of inducible urticaria.
evidence.supports: def：例子「冷」

evidence.quote: Eliciting factor: vertical pressure (wheals arising with a 3-12 h latency)
evidence.supports: def：例子「皮膚受壓」

evidence.quote: Eliciting factor: UV and/or visible light
evidence.supports: def：例子「陽光（紫外線或可見光）」

evidence.quote: CIndU is further subclassified as symptomatic dermographism, cold urticaria, delayed pressure urticaria, solar urticaria, heat urticaria, and vibratory angioedema (collectively referred to as chronic physical urticaria), as well as cholinergic urticaria, contact urticaria, and aquagenic urticaria.
evidence.supports: example：誘發型的亞型（寒冷性、延遲性壓力性、日光性、膽鹼性等）

evidence.quote: CU patients can concomitantly show more than one form of CU including more than one form of CIndU and they often do.
evidence.supports: note：兩型可能同時存在

evidence.quote: Some patients suffering from CSU experience trigger‐induced augmentation of wheals, angioedema, or both. Among others, these triggers include stress and infections.
evidence.supports: note：自發型也可能因壓力或感染而加重

entries.aka: chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU); chronic inducible urticaria (CIndU)
entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: S1's narrative sentences that define acute/chronic urticaria and CSU lost their bold subject words in the PMC extraction ('…spontaneous.is defined as…', '…it is described as).'), so they are not quoted; the Table 6 CSU cell is quoted only up to '> 6 weeks' because the following text is glued ('knownor unknown causes'). '沒有明確的誘發因子' does not mean 'no cause': S1 says 'CSU comes as CSU with known cause and CSU with unknown cause' (e.g., autoimmunity), and CSU can be worsened by nonspecific aggravators (stress, infections, NSAIDs) — the note covers stress/infection. The site uses 自發型/誘發型 as shorthand for the chronic forms (CSU/CIndU), which fits S1. '超過6週' follows S1/Kolkhir ('> 6 weeks'); the superseded Taiwanese Dermatological Association 2014 consensus (Chung WH et al., J Formos Med Assoc 2016;115(11):968-980; PMID 26679383; abstract checked) used '≥ 6 weeks'.

entries.def: 寒冷性蕁麻疹是誘發型蕁麻疹的一種：受冷後冒出膨疹或腫脹，膨疹常在回暖時出現。
entries.example: 冷空氣、冷風、冷水、冰冷的物品或冷飲。
entries.note: 全身受冷（例如游泳、跳進冷水）可能引起嚴重過敏反應。

evidence.quote: Cold urticaria (ColdU) is a common form of chronic inducible urticaria characterized by the development of wheals, angioedema or both in response to cold exposure.
evidence.supports: def：誘發型的一種，受冷後出現膨疹、腫脹或兩者

evidence.quote: We know that cold-induced wheals usually develop on rewarming and resolve within an hour and that anaphylaxis can occur.
evidence.supports: def：膨疹常在回暖時出現；note：可能發生嚴重過敏反應

evidence.quote: Eliciting factor: cold objects/air/fluids/wind
evidence.supports: example：冷的物品、冷空氣、冷的液體、冷風

evidence.quote: In the COLD-CE cohort, patients with typical ColdU reported the following triggers: cold air (88%), full-body cold-water immersion (68%), localized skin contact with cold liquids (65%), cold surfaces (59%), and ingestion of cold food or drinks (34%).
evidence.supports: example：冷空氣、冷水、冷的表面、冷食或冷飲

evidence.quote: These triggers are specific because each subtype of inducible urticaria has its own relevant trigger, such as exposure to cold in cold urticaria, and this trigger is not relevant in other forms of inducible urticaria.
evidence.supports: def：屬誘發型，誘發因子是冷

evidence.quote: Similar considerations hold for cold urticaria where the impact of the wind chill factor in cold winds needs to be remembered.
evidence.supports: example：冷風（與網站 UR-2.4 寒風一致）

evidence.quote: Cold urticaria (ColdU) is characterized by wheals, angioedema, or both, which are triggered by exposure to cold. A subset of patients experiences cold-induced anaphylaxis (ColdA), a potentially life-threatening systemic reaction.
evidence.supports: note：部分病人會出現寒冷誘發的嚴重過敏反應

evidence.quote: ColdA occurs more frequently in patients with mucosal angioedema involving the oropharynx. It is most commonly triggered by full-body cold exposure, such as swimming.
evidence.supports: note：最常由全身受冷（例如游泳）引發

evidence.quote: In cold urticaria, systemic reactions have been described in the case of a rapid change of skin temperature, for example, when patients jumped into cold water.
evidence.location: Section on physical urticarias ('Severity of Disease and PROs')
evidence.supports: note：例如跳進冷水

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: Site UR-2.3 (swimming → 全身性的過敏反應) is attributed to AAAAI/ACAAI 2014, which the research phase could read only via WebFetch; this entry instead uses WAO 2012 and Bizjak 2025 (both PMC full text), which state the same risk. S1 (2026) classifies cold urticaria as a CIndU subtype (footnote: 'Also called cold contact urticaria or acquired cold urticaria') but its PMC text gives no trigger list, so triggers come from WAO 2012 Table 1 and Bizjak 2025. The CIndU consensus (Magerl 2016, PMID 26991006) has no PMC full text and its abstract contains no subtype definitions, so it is not quoted. WAO 2012 Table 1 is marked 'Modified with permission from Zuberbier et al' (copyright 2009).

entries.def: 延遲性壓力性蕁麻疹是誘發型蕁麻疹的一種：皮膚持續受壓後，過了幾個小時才出現紅腫，常會痛。
entries.example: 提重物時，袋子提把造成的壓力。
entries.note: 壓力是力量除以面積；把提把加寬、分散壓力，可能有助預防。

evidence.quote: Eliciting factor: vertical pressure (wheals arising with a 3-12 h latency)
evidence.supports: def：受壓後延遲數小時（3–12小時）才出現

evidence.quote: Delayed pressure urticaria (DPU) is characterized by recurrent erythematous and often painful swelling after the skin is exposed to sustained pressure.
evidence.supports: def：皮膚持續受壓後出現紅腫，常會痛

evidence.quote: Delayed pressure urticaria (DPU) is a chronic inducible subtype of urticaria, characterized by painful erythematous swelling triggered by sustained mechanical pressure. After pressure stimuli, lesions often appear within 4 to 6 hours, peak around 6 hours later, and persist for 8 hours to 3 days.
evidence.supports: def：屬誘發型；受壓後常在4到6小時內出現

evidence.quote: For example, patients with delayed pressure urticaria should be informed that pressure is defined as force per area and that simple measures, such as broadening of the handle of heavy bags, may be helpful in the prevention of symptoms.
evidence.supports: example：重物袋子的提把；note：壓力＝力量÷面積，加寬提把可能有助預防

evidence.quote: For example, pressure is defined as force per area and simply increasing the size of a handle of a bag may help in patients with pressure urticaria to avoid symptoms.
evidence.supports: example／note：同上

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: Sources give different latencies: WAO 2012 Table 1 '3-12 h'; Kulthanan 2025 'within 4 to 6 hours' (and AAAAI/ACAAI 2014 '4 to 6 hours' per the research-phase WebFetch). The definition says 「過了幾個小時」 to stay within all of them. '常會痛' follows Kulthanan 2020/2025 ('often painful', 'painful erythematous swelling'). The example and note match site UR-2.5 and S1 §5.2.2 (bag handles; 'pressure is defined as force per area').

entries.def: 日光性蕁麻疹是誘發型蕁麻疹的一種：皮膚照到光線後幾分鐘內，就冒出會癢的紅斑和膨疹；引發的光線多為紫外線A（UV-A）或可見光。
entries.note: 醫師可用不同波長的光做測試，找出引發的光線，可能有助挑選防曬乳或有UV-A濾光的燈泡。

evidence.quote: Solar urticaria is a rare and debilitating photodermatosis classified as a subtype of inducible (physical) urticaria. It is characterized by the rapid onset of pruritic erythema and wheals within minutes of exposure to light
evidence.supports: def：屬誘發型；照光後幾分鐘內出現會癢的紅斑和膨疹

evidence.quote: In affected individuals, symptoms are reproducibly triggered by specific wavelengths of radiation, most commonly within the ultraviolet A (UVA) and visible light (VL) spectra, as determined by phototesting
evidence.supports: def：引發的光線多為紫外線A或可見光

evidence.quote: Eliciting factor: UV and/or visible light
evidence.supports: def：誘發因子是紫外線和／或可見光

evidence.quote: Provocation with UV and visible light of different wave lengths and threshold test
evidence.supports: note：用不同波長的光做測試

evidence.quote: For solar urticaria, the exact identification of the range of eliciting wave lengths may be important for the appropriate selection of sunscreens or light bulbs with a UV‐A filter.
evidence.supports: note：找出引發的波長，可能有助挑選防曬乳或有UV-A濾光的燈泡

evidence.quote: Due to the limited effectiveness of sunscreens in protecting against UVA and VL
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：防曬乳對UVA與可見光的保護有限

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: Engler Markowitz 2025 (systematic review) notes 'the limited effectiveness of sunscreens in protecting against UVA and VL'. This does not contradict site UR-2.T, which says identifying wavelengths 'may' help choose sunscreens or UV-A-filtered bulbs (S1), but you may want to avoid implying that sunscreen alone is protective. '紫外線A' renders UVA; the site writes 'UV-A'. S1 also states that advising solar-urticaria patients to avoid going outdoors 'should not be the aim', consistent with site UR-2.2.

entries.def: 膽鹼性蕁麻疹是誘發型蕁麻疹的一種：體溫上升而流汗時（例如運動、泡熱水澡、情緒緊張），冒出針尖大小、很癢或會痛的膨疹，周圍泛紅。
entries.note: 運動時冒疹子也可能是運動誘發的嚴重過敏反應，需由醫師區分。

sources.citation: Fukunaga A, et al. Cholinergic Urticaria: Subtype Classification and Clinical Approach. Am J Clin Dermatol 2023;24(1):41-54.

evidence.quote: Cholinergic urticaria (CholU) is a subtype of chronic inducible urticaria with a chief complaint of itching and/or stinging, painful papular wheals that develop simultaneously with sweating.
evidence.supports: def：屬誘發型；流汗時出現很癢或刺痛的膨疹

evidence.quote: manifests as pinpoint, highly pruritic, or often painful wheals with surrounding erythema. These wheals occur after sweating induced by an increase in the body temperature, which occurs in response to hot bathing, physical exercise, and emotional stress
evidence.supports: def：針尖大小、很癢或常會痛的膨疹，周圍泛紅；體溫上升流汗時出現，例如泡熱水澡、運動、情緒緊張

evidence.quote: Cholinergic urticaria symptoms can be elicited through a hot shower or bath. The underlying mechanism in cholinergic urticaria, however, is not the external stimulus but the increase in body core temperature; cholinergic urticaria can also be elicited by exercise or emotional distress
evidence.supports: def：機轉是體溫（核心體溫）上升，可由熱水澡、運動或情緒緊張引發

evidence.quote: Elicitation by increase of body core temperature due to physical exercises, spicy food
evidence.supports: def：核心體溫上升（例如運動）

evidence.quote: Exercise-induced anaphylaxis includes four types: food-independent EIA, food-dependent EIA with IgE sensitivity, food-dependent EIA without IgE sensitivity, and drug-dependent EIA
evidence.supports: note：EIA＝運動誘發的嚴重過敏反應

evidence.quote: Cholinergic urticaria must be differentiated from EIA and heat urticaria based on whether the clinical episode has developed secondary to exercise and/or heat stimulation.
evidence.supports: note：需和運動誘發的嚴重過敏反應區分

evidence.quote: Strenuous exertion may provoke both EIA and CholU, but passive warming will induce solely CholU and not EIA.
evidence.supports: note：劇烈運動兩者都可能引發

evidence.quote: For example, advising patients with cholinergic urticaria to completely avoid physical exercise or recommending that patients with solar urticaria avoid going outdoors should not be the aim of a patient‐centered management strategy.
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes：S1 認為不應要求膽鹼性蕁麻疹病人完全不運動（網站 UR-2.2）

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: Site UR-S2 is attributed to AAAAI/ACAAI 2014 (WebFetch-only in the research phase); Fukunaga 2023 (PMC full text) supports the same point that cholinergic urticaria must be distinguished from exercise-induced anaphylaxis. WAO 2012 Table 1 also lists 'spicy food' as an elicitor and Fukunaga mentions hot or spicy foods; these were left out of the definition for brevity. S1 says advising complete avoidance of exercise 'should not be the aim' (site UR-2.2); this was deliberately NOT put in the note, so the note does not imply that exercise is safe before a doctor has excluded exercise-induced anaphylaxis.

entries.def: 膨疹是皮膚淺層突然腫起的一塊，大小、形狀不一，周圍常有一圈紅暈，會癢（有時是灼熱感），通常在24小時內消退、恢復原狀。
entries.note: 膨疹來得快、去得快，看診時不一定還在，可以先拍照給醫師看。

evidence.quote: Urticaria is characterized by the sudden appearance of wheals and/or angioedema, defining wheals as a cutaneous swelling of variable size, almost invariably surrounded by a reflex erythema, with associated itching or, sometimes, a burning sensation, and of transient nature, with the skin returning to its normal appearance in usually 1 to 24 hours.
evidence.supports: def：突然出現、大小不一的腫起，周圍幾乎都有紅暈，會癢或有時灼熱，會自行消退、通常1到24小時內恢復

evidence.quote: Wheals are sharply circumscribed, superficial skin swellings that vary in size and shape, and are typically pruritic. They are often surrounded by erythematous flare.
evidence.supports: def：皮膚淺層的腫起，大小形狀不一，通常會癢，周圍常有紅暈

evidence.quote: Urticaria is a condition characterized by the development of wheals (hives), angioedema, or both.
evidence.supports: aka：wheals (hives)；膨疹是蕁麻疹的主要表現

evidence.quote: Since wheals and angioedema are transient and may not be present at the time of physical examination, it is important to review prior documentation, including patient‐provided photographs of wheals and/or angioedema
evidence.supports: note：會消退、看診時不一定還在，可提供照片

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: S1 (2026) §3.1 defines urticaria ('wheals (hives), angioedema, or both') but its PMC text gives no feature-by-feature definition of a wheal; the 2018 and 2022 versions of the guideline have no PMC full text (checked with convert_article_ids), so the definition is quoted from the WAO 2012 position paper (PMC) and Bizjak 2025 (PMC). WAO 2012 gives 'usually 1 to 24 hours'; the entry says 「通常在24小時內」 and does not state a lower bound. WAO 2012 says the wheal is 'almost invariably' surrounded by reflex erythema and Bizjak says 'often'; the entry uses 「常有」.

entries.def: 血管性水腫是皮膚深層或黏膜突然出現的明顯腫脹，可能會痛而不是癢，消退得比膨疹慢，可能要到72小時。
entries.note: 可和膨疹一起或單獨出現；只有腫脹時請醫師找原因。喉嚨腫脹可能危及生命。

evidence.quote: Angioedema can be defined as a sudden and pronounced swelling of the deep dermis and subcutaneous tissue or mucous membranes, with a painful rather than an itching sensation and a slower resolution than for wheals that can take up to 72 hours
evidence.supports: def：皮膚深層、皮下組織或黏膜突然明顯腫脹，痛而非癢，消退比膨疹慢，可達72小時

evidence.quote: Angioedema (AE) manifests with intermittent, localized, self-limiting swelling of the subcutaneous and/or submucosal tissue.
evidence.supports: def：局部、會自行消退的皮下或黏膜下腫脹

evidence.quote: In angioedema, similar changes occur primarily in the lower dermis and the subcutis.
evidence.supports: def：發生在皮膚較深層與皮下

evidence.quote: In contrast, cutaneous angioedema presents with deeper, erythematous, or skin-colored swellings with poorly defined borders.
evidence.supports: def：比膨疹更深層的腫脹

evidence.quote: Recurrent angioedema (RecA) is a frequent clinical problem characterized by suddenly occurring cutaneous and/or mucosal swellings. Depending on their location, RecA may be painful, hindering, disfiguring, or even life-threatening.
evidence.supports: def：突然出現的皮膚或黏膜腫脹；「可能會痛」

evidence.quote: AE is heterogeneous, can be hereditary or acquired, may occur only once or be recurrent, may exhibit wheals or not, and may be due to mast cell mediators, bradykinin, or other mechanisms.
evidence.supports: note：可伴隨膨疹，也可能沒有；原因可能不同

evidence.quote: On the other hand, in patients who suffer exclusively from recurrent angioedema (but not from wheals), differential diagnosis should include bradykinin‐mediated angioedema, including those induced by angiotensin‐converting enzyme (ACE)‐inhibitor or gliptins, or hereditary angioedema (HAE)
evidence.supports: note：只有腫脹、沒有膨疹時，需評估其他類型（例如緩激肽引起的）

evidence.quote: Angioedema of the upper airway can be life threatening.
evidence.supports: note（喉嚨腫脹可能危及生命）

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: '可能會痛而不是癢' softens WAO 2012's categorical 'a painful rather than an itching sensation' (Weller 2013 likewise says recurrent angioedema 'may be painful'). The note avoids naming drug classes; S1 names ACE inhibitors and gliptins for angioedema without wheals (site UR-S3 already says 「例如某些降血壓藥」, which is an interpretation of 'ACE-inhibitor' not stated in the quote itself).

entries.def: 嚴重過敏反應是最嚴重的一種全身性過敏反應，通常發作很快，可能危及呼吸或血液循環，甚至致命。
entries.example: 呼吸困難、咻咻聲、喘鳴、嘴唇或舌頭腫、頭暈或昏倒。
entries.note: 這是急症，需立刻處理；不一定有皮膚症狀。寒冷性蕁麻疹病人游泳等全身受冷時也可能發生。

evidence.quote: Anaphylaxis is the most severe clinical presentation of acute systemic allergic reactions.
evidence.supports: def：最嚴重的一種全身性過敏反應

evidence.quote: Anaphylaxis is a serious systemic hypersensitivity reaction that is usually rapid in onset and may cause death. Severe anaphylaxis is characterized by potentially life-threatening compromise in breathing and/or the circulation, and may occur without typical skin features or circulatory shock being present.
evidence.location: Section 'A revised definition for anaphylaxis' (WAO Anaphylaxis Committee)
evidence.supports: def：通常發作很快、可能致命，嚴重時危及呼吸或循環；note：不一定有典型皮膚症狀

evidence.quote: Early suspicion of anaphylaxis, either by patients or health-professionals, based on the development of symptoms suggestive of allergy usually affecting several organ systems more or less simultaneously, should prompt immediate management. Anaphylaxis is a medical emergency that requires rapid identification and treatment.
evidence.supports: note：急症，需立刻處理；症狀常同時影響多個器官

evidence.quote: how to recognize anaphylaxis symptoms (eg, tingling in the extremities, sense of heat, sense of dizziness/fainting, swollen lips-tongue-uvula, shortness of breath, wheeze, stridor, collapse)
evidence.location: Section on self-management (written anaphylaxis emergency action plan)
evidence.supports: example：呼吸急促、咻咻聲、喘鳴、嘴唇舌頭腫、頭暈或昏倒、虛脫

evidence.quote: Cold urticaria (ColdU) is characterized by wheals, angioedema, or both, which are triggered by exposure to cold. A subset of patients experiences cold-induced anaphylaxis (ColdA), a potentially life-threatening systemic reaction.
evidence.supports: note：寒冷性蕁麻疹病人全身受冷可能發生

evidence.quote: ColdA occurs more frequently in patients with mucosal angioedema involving the oropharynx. It is most commonly triggered by full-body cold exposure, such as swimming.
evidence.supports: note：最常由全身受冷（例如游泳）引發

evidence.quote: Therefore, the majority of anaphylaxis reactions cannot be described as life-threatening in themselves
evidence.location: Section 'Definition and clinical diagnostic criteria for anaphylaxis'
evidence.supports: def 措辭：寫「可能…甚至致命」而非「一定危及生命」

entries.confidence: High
entries.reviewer_notes: WAO 2020's own table of definitions is missing from the PMC extraction; the formal wording is quoted from Turner 2019, the WAO Anaphylaxis Committee paper that proposed it (PMC). Whether WAO 2020 repeats this wording verbatim was not verified. Alias 全身性反應 removed. UR-2.3 now reads 「…可能引起全身性的過敏反應…」 (AAAAI/ACAAI 2014 'systemic reactions') and is not linked to this entry; its popup is cold-urticaria. The example symptoms come from WAO 2020's action-plan list for at-risk patients; 「呼吸困難」 renders 'shortness of breath'. The emergency number 119 (site UR-S1) is editorial and not in any source.

entries.def: 咻咻聲是呼吸時像吹口哨的聲音，多在吐氣時出現，因為支氣管收縮；喘鳴在這裡指吸氣時發出的尖銳高音，因為上呼吸道阻塞。
entries.note: 兩者都可能是嚴重過敏反應的徵兆，屬於急症。

evidence.location: Table 2 ('Proposed parameters for guided patient history'), 'Respiratory manifestations' row
evidence.supports: def：咻咻聲＝主要在吐氣時、因支氣管收縮的口哨聲；喘鳴＝吸氣時、因呼吸道阻塞的高音

evidence.quote: Stridor is a high-pitched respiratory sound that signals upper airway obstruction.
evidence.supports: def：喘鳴是代表上呼吸道阻塞的高音（佐證）

evidence.quote: how to recognize anaphylaxis symptoms (eg, tingling in the extremities, sense of heat, sense of dizziness/fainting, swollen lips-tongue-uvula, shortness of breath, wheeze, stridor, collapse)

Anaphylaxis is a medical emergency that requires rapid identification and treatment.
evidence.supports: note：屬於急症

entries.confidence: Medium
entries.reviewer_notes: WAO 2020 (Tier 1) lists 'wheeze, stridor' as anaphylaxis symptoms but does not define them; no Tier 1–2 plain-language definition was found (the ERS lung-sound nomenclature paper, PMID 26647442, has no definitions in its abstract and no PMC full text). The definitions come from a review table (Bizjak 2025, PMC) and, for stridor, an infant-focused review abstract (Clark 2018) whose opening definition is general; hence Medium confidence. Terminology: the site renders wheeze as 咻咻聲 and stridor as 喘鳴, matching WAO's 'wheeze, stridor'. In Taiwanese clinical usage 喘鳴 is sometimes also used for wheezing, so please confirm this mapping. 醫師決定（2026-10-08）：依 WAO 用法，咻咻聲＝wheeze、喘鳴＝stridor。

entries.def: 一種主要影響脊椎和薦腸關節（脊椎和骨盆之間的關節）的慢性發炎性疾病；包括 X 光看得到結構破壞的僵直性脊椎炎，以及 X 光看不到這種破壞的非放射線型。
entries.note: 也可能影響其他關節和肌腱附著處，或出現急性前葡萄膜炎、乾癬、發炎性腸道疾病等骨骼肌肉以外的表現。

evidence.quote: Axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) is a chronic inflammatory condition that predominantly affects the spine and sacroiliac joints
evidence.supports: def：慢性發炎性疾病，主要影響脊椎與薦腸關節

evidence.quote: It can also involve peripheral joints and entheses, and extra-musculoskeletal manifestations (EMMs) such as acute anterior uveitis, psoriasis and IBD.
evidence.supports: note：其他關節、肌腱附著處；急性前葡萄膜炎、乾癬、發炎性腸道疾病

evidence.quote: The diagnosis of axSpA should be verified by a consultant rheumatologist, and includes ankylosing spondylitis (radiographic axSpA) and non-radiographic axSpA with objective features of inflammation (elevated CRP and/or MRI findings).

evidence.supports: def：包括僵直性脊椎炎與非放射線型

evidence.quote: Axial spondyloarthritis is a chronic type of arthritis that primarily affects the sacroiliac joints and the spine.
evidence.supports: def：慢性關節炎，主要影響薦腸關節與脊椎

evidence.quote: axSpA has been categorized into radiographic axSpA, which is largely synonymous with ankylosing spondylitis (AS) and presents with radiographically visible structural damage to the sacroiliac joint and axial skeleton; and non‐radiographic axSpA (nr‐axSpA), a milder form of axSpA that does not exhibit such structural damage but nevertheless imposes a heavy burden of disease.
evidence.supports: def：X 光看得到結構破壞＝僵直性脊椎炎；看不到＝非放射線型

evidence.quote: The term axial spondyloarthritis covers both patients with non-radiographic and radiographic axial spondyloarthritis, which is also termed ankylosing spondylitis.
evidence.supports: def：涵蓋兩型；放射線型即僵直性脊椎炎

evidence.quote: The sacroiliac joint (SIJ) is the articulation surface between the sacrum and the ilium and plays an important role in the distribution of axial load between the spine and pelvis
evidence.supports: def（薦腸關節＝脊椎和骨盆之間的關節）

evidence.quote: Not all people with axSpA will undergo structural progression detectable on radiographs (radiographic progression)
evidence.supports: def（非放射線型不一定會出現 X 光可見的破壞）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text or abstract, Tier 1–2)
entries.reviewer_notes: Definition from BSR 2025 (site-cited, Tier 1, PMC) and TRA 2020 (Taiwan, PMC); Sieper & Poddubnyy 2017 (Lancet abstract) agrees that axSpA covers radiographic axSpA (= ankylosing spondylitis) and non-radiographic axSpA. TRA calls nr-axSpA "a milder form"; not used in def because BSR/Sieper do not say so. The gloss 「脊椎和骨盆之間的關節」 for 薦腸關節 rests on Ulas 2023 (sacrum–ilium articulation between spine and pelvis). ASAS-EULAR 2022 (PMID 36270658) abstract has no definition; ASAS classification papers were not needed. CM-1.5 site wording is consistent.

entries.term: 急性前葡萄膜炎（虹彩炎）
entries.def: 葡萄膜炎是眼球內部的發炎。前葡萄膜炎是眼睛前段（虹膜等處）的發炎，虹彩炎（虹膜發炎）就屬於這一類；急性型會突然發作，常只有一眼，也可能兩眼輪流復發。
entries.example: 常見症狀：怕光、眼睛痛、眼睛紅、視力模糊。
entries.note: 屬急症，要盡快看眼科；延誤治療，有些人可能出現青光眼或視力嚴重受損。

evidence.quote: The uveitides are a collection of over 30 diseases characterized by intraocular inflammation.
evidence.supports: def：葡萄膜炎＝眼球內部的發炎

evidence.quote: The uveitic classes are defined anatomically by the primary site in which inflammation is detected clinically and consist of: anterior uveitis (primary site in the anterior chamber), intermediate uveitis (primary site in the vitreous), posterior uveitis (primary site in the retina or choroid), and panuveitis (anterior chamber, vitreous, and retina/choroid all typically involved without predominance in any one site).
evidence.supports: def：前葡萄膜炎＝發炎主要在眼睛前段（前房）

evidence.quote: Anterior uveitis (AU) is characterized by the inflammation of the iris and ciliary body and is the most frequent extra-articular manifestation of spondyloarthritis (SpA).
evidence.supports: def：虹彩與睫狀體發炎（故虹彩炎屬於前葡萄膜炎）

evidence.quote: HLA-B27 associated uveitis classically presents as a symptomatic, unilateral, sudden onset, and limited duration anterior segment inflammation, and is typically characterized as acute anterior uveitis.

evidence.quote: Symptoms frequently include photophobia, ocular pain, eye redness and blurred vision.

evidence.quote: Recurrence can occur in either eye and it is common to see inflammatory episodes ‘flip-flop’ between eyes.

evidence.quote: The typical pattern for SpA-associated uveitis is a recurrent acute, unilateral or unilateral alternating, anterior uveitis.

evidence.quote: Acute anterior uveitis is the most frequent type associated with AS, and should be managed as an emergency to avoid complications

evidence.quote: Generally, axSpA patients with anterior uveitis should be referred to an ophthalmologist as soon as possible, as inflammation can lead to papillary and lens dysfunction with blurring of vision, and glaucoma and severe impairment of vision can occur in some cases if adequate treatment is delayed.

evidence.quote: Acute anterior uveitis is the most common EMM that can occur in up to a quarter of people with axSpA

evidence.quote: According to GRADE, a recommendation is categorized as strong if the panel is very confident that the benefits of an intervention clearly outweigh the harms (or vice versa); a conditional recommendation denotes uncertainty regarding the balance of benefits and harms, such as when the evidence quality is low or very low, or when the decision is particularly sensitive to individual patient preferences, or when costs are expected to affect the decision.
evidence.supports: note（建議有強／有條件之分）

evidence.quote: Thus, conditional recommendations refer to decisions in which incorporation of patient preferences and values is an essential element of shared decision making.
evidence.supports: note（有條件建議要和醫師共同決定）

evidence.quote: A strong recommendation in favour of an intervention was made when the benefits clearly outweighed the risks, or vice versa (recommendation against), for nearly all people with SLE, or weak when risks and benefits were more closely balanced or where there was more uncertainty.
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes（核對網站「強烈建議／建議」說明）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text; IOM definition quoted in a PubMed-indexed definitional paper, plus Tier-1 site-cited guidelines)
entries.reviewer_notes: IOM 2011 definition is taken as quoted (in quotation marks) in Morizane 2025 (PMC full text); the original IOM report is not PubMed-indexed and was not read, so its exact original wording (e.g. singular/plural of "systematic review(s)") was not checked. The site also calls EULAR/ASAS "recommendations" 指引; this fits the general IOM sense (recommendations informed by systematic review). Site legend check: 強烈建議／建議 wording is consistent with the GRADE definitions quoted from ACR 2022 (strong = benefits clearly outweigh harms; conditional = uncertain balance, preference-sensitive, shared decision making) and with BSR 2026 SLE ("strong ... for nearly all people with SLE, or weak when risks and benefits were more closely balanced or where there was more uncertainty"). Alias 指引 is very frequent on the site; consider linking only its first occurrence per page.

entries.note: 系統性回顧不一定會把數據合併計算；有合併計算的部分稱為統合分析。

evidence.supports: reviewer_notes（合併的是觀察性研究）

evidence.quote: The pooled odds ratio for the response to antimalarials in smoker patients with CLE (n = 797) was 0.53 (95% confidence interval 0.29-0.98) compared with nonsmokers (n = 601).
evidence.supports: reviewer_notes（合併結果與信賴區間）

entries.confidence: High (PMC full text Tier 2 definition; site-cited meta-analysis abstract for the example)

The authors' "2-fold decrease" supports 「明顯」, but the pooled OR 0.53 has a wide 95% CI (0.29-0.98) whose upper bound is close to 1; the physician may keep or soften 「明顯」. entries.def: 隨機對照試驗是把參加者用隨機（類似抽籤）的方式分組，一組接受要測試的治療，另一組作為比較，再看兩組結果的差別。
entries.example: ACR痛風指引提到的兩個維生素C小型試驗（29人和40人）。
entries.note: 隨機分組讓各組條件相近；設計良好時被視為評估治療效果的黃金標準，但人數少時結果較不精確。

entries.def: 觀察性研究是研究者不安排誰接受哪種治療或習慣，只記錄大家實際的情況，再分析這些情況和健康結果有沒有關聯。
entries.example: 比較吃櫻桃和沒吃櫻桃的期間，痛風發作的風險。
entries.note: 結果通常只能說明「有關聯」，因為無法排除其他因素的影響；證據確定性通常較低。

entries.def: 安慰劑是外觀像真的治療、但沒有真正療效的「假治療」（例如假藥丸、假針灸），研究中用來和真的治療比較。

entries.note: 拿到安慰劑的人有時也會覺得改善，所以真的治療要比安慰劑好，才算有效。

entries.def: 證據確定性是指我們對研究結果有多少把握：真正的效果和研究估計的是否接近。通常分為高、中、低、極低四級。

entries.note: 確定性低，表示新研究很可能改變這個結果，結論也可能不同；「證據品質」是較早的說法，現在仍常用。

entries.reviewer_notes: Confidence basis: definition is the Institute of Medicine wording quoted in a PMC-verified Cochrane CAM Field paper (second-hand); note from NICE NG100 via WebFetch (matching research-phase reading). This is a definition of 'complementary and alternative medicine'; NICE uses 'complementary therapies' without defining it (WebFetch check of NG100). Wieland 2011 lists acupuncture, homeopathy, herbal medicine, traditional Chinese medicine and chiropractic as CAM from a US/European perspective. No example was given because in Taiwan Chinese medicine (including acupuncture) is licensed within the health system, so what counts as 'mainstream' differs (the IOM definition is relative to 'a particular society'). Also note that ACR 2022 conditionally recommends acupuncture and massage for RA. PubMed lists NICE NG100 as book record PMID 30102507 (a 2018 NICE rheumatoid arthritis record by field search; metadata not retrievable). Wieland 2011 has no DOI in PubMed.

evidence.quote: For all populations, doing some physical activity is better than doing none. If individuals are not currently meeting these recommendations, doing some physical activity will bring benefits to health. Individuals should start with small amounts of physical activity and gradually increase frequency, intensity and duration over time.

entries.aka: good practice statement (GPS); also called best practice statement; ungraded, consensus-based statement
entries.confidence: Medium–High (definition from PMC full text of a GRADE-methods paper by GRADE Working Group members, Tier 2–3; supported by a Tier 1 ACR 2025 guideline abstract and JMA J 2025 PMC text). The 'good practice' label for the WHO tip itself is not machine-verifiable in a PubMed-indexed text.
entries.reviewer_notes: Site usage: only the strength label 「WHO 2020・良好實務建議」 under tip CM-1.T. The tip's content matches Bull 2020 (quoted). The label itself could not be confirmed in a PubMed-indexed text: the phrase 'good practice' does not occur anywhere in the PMC text of Bull 2020 (PMID 33239350); in its Table 4 the same advice follows a heading lost in extraction (text reads ':.If not currently meeting these recommendations, doing some physical activity will bring benefits to health. Start with small amounts...'). The label therefore rests on the WHO guideline book cited on the site as S5 (NCBI Bookshelf NBK566048), which is not PubMed-indexed and was not read here; please confirm that WHO calls this a good practice statement there. The primary GRADE guidance papers (Guyatt GH et al. J Clin Epidemiol 2015;68(5):597-600, PMID 25660962, 'Guideline panels should not GRADE good practice statements'; Guyatt GH et al. J Clin Epidemiol 2016;80:3-7, PMID 27452192, 'Guideline panels should seldom make good practice statements: guidance from the GRADE Working Group') have no PubMed abstract and no PMC text via the tool, so they were not quoted; Dewidar 2022 summarises them. Wording choices: 「不分級」 = 'ungraded'; 「專家共識認為」 = 'consensus-based' / 'grounded in expert consensus'; 「依據的多是間接證據」 = 'supported by indirect evidence'; 「所以不另評證據等級」 compresses Dewidar's reasoning that GRADE would wrongly rate such evidence low/very low for indirectness despite high certainty of net benefit. Note 「沒有分級不代表不重要」 paraphrases 'deemed to be necessary for practice' and 'intended to be interpreted as strong recommendations'. The example comes from a paediatric oncology guideline (the only short, lay-friendly GPS example found in a PubMed abstract); drop it if it seems out of place on a rheumatology site. The ACR 2025 SLE citation gives the PubMed fields (volume 78, issue 7, epub 2025 Nov 4); the print-issue year is not shown by the tool. Suggest adding 良好實務建議 to the site legend (怎麼看每則建議下方的小字), which currently has no entry for it.

evidence.quote: It is important to note that when choosing a sunscreen, UV-B protection is indicated by the SPF while UV-A protection is indicated by the UV-A logo or the UV-A star system (i.e. one to five stars).

entries.aka: UVA protection labelling: Protection Grade of UVA (PA+ to PA++++, based on persistent pigment darkening); UK UVA logo and UVA star system (one to five stars)
entries.confidence: Medium for the UK UVA logo / star system (Tier 1 BSR 2026, PMC full text). Low for the PA system: the only accessible PubMed-indexed description is an editorial in Cureus (Patel 2026, PMC full text); no Tier 1–3 dermatology source describing the PA grades could be read.
entries.reviewer_notes: PA SOURCE QUALITY: Patel 2026 is a Cureus editorial by two authors affiliated with NovoBliss Research Private Limited (clinical research operations, Ahmedabad, India); its Table 2 also calls JCIA the 'Japan Chemical Industry Association' while its text says 'Japan Cosmetic Industry Association', so editorial quality is limited. It is used only for what the PA grades are called and their order (PA+ some, PA++ moderate, PA+++ high, PA++++ very high UVA protection) and that PA is Japanese and widely used in Asian markets. Better sources that probably describe PA (Moyal 2010 Photochem Photobiol Sci, PMID 20354645; Moyal 2012 Indian J Dermatol Venereol Leprol, PMID 22710110) are abstract-only and their abstracts do not describe PA; Moyal 2006 (PMID 16719864) describes in its abstract 'The Japanese Cosmetic Industry Association (JCIA) PPD method' used to determine UVA protection factors. The PPD/UVA-PF ranges behind each PA grade were not stated in any accessible source, so no numbers are given. TAIWAN: no PubMed-indexed source on Taiwanese sunscreen labelling rules was found; the entry therefore says only 「亞洲常見」. UK LABEL: BSR says 'UV-A logo'; its shape (a circle) is not described in any accessible source, so the entry says 「UVA 標誌」. The BSR 'high' standard (SPF at least 30 plus UVA logo or 4–5 stars) is adopted from the British Association of Dermatologists. CONFLICT: BSR 2026 states 'SPF and UV-A protection are often linked, so a higher SPF sunscreen will have more UV-A protection' (citing BAD), whereas Young 2026 (38 SPF 50/50+ products, ISO 24442 in vivo PPD testing; funded by La Roche-Posay/L'Oréal) found 'a lack of relationship between SPF and UVA-PF values'; the entry does not say that a high SPF implies high UVA protection. The note does not equate PA grades with UK stars (no source maps one to the other). LINKING: the alias 「UVA 防護等級」 (normal space, exactly as in SL-1.2) is longer than the uva-uvb alias 「UVA」, so in SL-1.2 the second 「UVA」 (now a [repeat] of uva-uvb) becomes this entry's link, while 「（同時防 UVA 和 UVB）」 stays linked to uva-uvb; please confirm the site's JavaScript applies the same longest-match rule. 醫師決定（2026-10-08）：保留 PA 等級說明（出處證據力弱，已知）。
